notes: Manually reviewed every eligible production JS/TS file, including CLI, local API barrels, Chrome-extension source, declaration files, and scripts/copy-chrome-extension.mjs. All 670 files under extensions/browser have reviewed or excluded records. No plugin-owned local import leaves the plugin root.

Package metadata declares index.ts and the Chrome-extension asset copy script. The packaging script and extension-install-layout.ts filter tests and declarations from copied assets, but this source-phase audit includes eligible declaration files and source outside runtime reachability; it is not a published-artifact inventory.

benchmark-api.ts and scripts/bench-lightweight.ts are an opt-in synthetic benchmark pair, with the former called only by the latter. They and the two server-context harnesses have verified test-only caller boundaries and are excluded individually. Searches across eligible production source found no imports of excluded tests, helper files, or fixtures.

BrowserStateRuntime is a plugin-owned structure passed to createPluginRuntimeStore. Only its gateway field has PluginRuntime provenance (browser-runtime-state.ts:34 and session-tab-store.ts:191,205), so gateway accesses map to runtime.gateway and runtime.gateway.request. sessionTabs, dashboardOperations, sessionDashboards, dashboardEvents, and similar custom state fields are not host runtime members.

initializeBrowserSessionTabStore receives api.runtime at plugin-registration.ts:250. Its state.openKeyedStore access is typed through Pick<PluginRuntime["state"], "openKeyedStore">. Bare runtime-handle transfer does not add runtime or api.runtime identities; PluginRuntime["gateway"] contributes a gateway type dependency, while Pick<PluginRuntime["state"], "openKeyedStore"> explicitly selects the maximal runtime.state.openKeyedStore type dependency.

Chrome extension runtime objects, BrowserServerState/ProfileRuntimeState, lazy module handles, SDK gateway request contexts, SDK keyed-store results, and the CLI defaultRuntime output helper are not OpenClawPluginApi or PluginRuntime handles. SDK free-function calls do not imply internal host API/runtime usage.

SDK symbols retain original export names through local aliases and reexports, including readRuntimeConfig/getRuntimeConfig and parseBrowserHttpUrl/parseHttpUrl. Explicit typeof/type references merge export classifications with value imports where applicable; SDK-module classification follows module dependency syntax. No genuinely nonstatic SDK API/runtime accesses or hook names remained unresolved.

Import/reexport dependencies are recorded even if unused. Evidence is representative per identity/file/reference category rather than exhaustive call telemetry; findingCount counts distinct findings evidenced in each reviewed file.

Reconciled the root-approved literal Pick rule: session-tab-store.ts:190 selects runtime.state.openKeyedStore, making that finding mixed with its calls. The incidental runtime.state prefix was removed because no independent occurrence references it. Other reviewed Pick/Omit expressions select plugin-owned types, SDK config/request types, or third-party types rather than OpenClawPluginApi/PluginRuntime members; broad Omit and inferred object types are not expanded.

Reconciled exact referenceKinds against the already reviewed source: SDK function/constructor calls and methods rooted directly in imported SDK objects carry call evidence; explicit SDK-type annotations carry type-reference evidence. A call occurrence contributes call rather than a duplicate member-access category; separate non-call properties such as ErrorCodes.INVALID_REQUEST, WebSocket.OPEN, and WEBHOOK_BODY_READ_DEFAULTS.preAuth contribute member-access. Plain imported scalar/array value uses have no additional kind in the frozen enum. SDK module findings retain dependency-site categories, and SDK return-value members are not expanded.

Final local-barrel reconciliation: browser-config.ts/browser-profiles.ts forward browser-cdp exports and ResolvedBrowserTabCleanupConfig; runtime-api.ts forwards resolveExistingPathsWithinRoot. Their reexports and downstream local imports belong to the original SDK-export identities. Removed local-reexport evidence/kinds from the browser-cdp, ssrf-runtime, and security-runtime SDK-module findings, which retain direct SDK-specifier sites only. Dynamic local imports in session-tab-cleanup-claim.ts select plugin-owned helpers rather than SDK-valued exports; no local composite namespace star was inferred.
